content: Git's object store is the canonical content-addressable + append-only pattern: object id = hash(content), objects immutable once written, refs/branches are the only mutable pointers layered on top. Directly analogous to an artifact registry (content-hash keyed, never mutated) plus a ledger (append-only log of promotion events, with an 'active pointer' derived from the log, matching the frozen contract's own 'ledger wins on disagreement' rule).
